name: Remove or deprecate a content entry (item, spell, effect, enemy, recipe, quest …)
trigger: A def should stop existing or be replaced. Ids never change after shipping in a save (R7), so shipped content is deprecated, not deleted.
director: none — unless the content is named in the spec (§6.9 Fireball) or a spec section

steps.verify: has the id ever shipped in a save or a tagged build?
steps.note: Never shipped: delete. Shipped: deprecate (keep the def, mark it, redirect).

steps.verify: run G2 after removing the def: every failure is a reference you must fix first
steps.note: G2 is the reference finder: recipes, loot tables, quests, dialogue, vendors, spawn rules, starting kits.

steps.verify: recipes that output or consume it are retired or re-pointed
entries naming it are removed or re-pointed
objectives and rewards naming it are re-pointed
spawn sets naming a retired enemy are updated
note: old id → replacement id (or none), the save behavior for players who hold it
old saves holding the id get the replacement or a refund on load
delete (never shipped) or mark deprecated with the replacement id
asset removed with the def, or kept while deprecated
passes: no dangling reference
boots; an old save (if any) loads without ERROR lines
if a whole system went away: `set-node <id> status=non-goal phase=—` or `remove-node` after `remove-edge`
steps.note: Content retirement alone changes no registry row.
